cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
import sys, json, pathlib
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
lim = np.asarray(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['range_rad'])

def target(rad):
    return np.clip(2 * (np.asarray(rad) - lim[:, 0]) / (lim[:, 1] - lim[:, 0]) - 1, -1, 1)

def move_to(leg_hip, knee, ankle, n, label):
    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=['room_camera'], video='none')
    start = np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][:19], dtype=float)
    goal = start.copy()
    goal[[2,7]] = leg_hip
    goal[[3,8]] = knee
    goal[[4,9]] = ankle
    goal[10:] = 0
    rows = np.stack([target(start + (goal-start)*t) for t in np.linspace(1/n, 1, n)])
    out = r.submit('joint_position', rows, dt=0.02, interpolate='hold', cameras=['room_camera'], video='none', note=label)
    out.save('/app/output/'+label)
    p = np.asarray(out.meta['proprio']['now'])
    print(json.dumps({'label':label,'steps':out.meta['control_steps'],'done':out.done,'reason':out.meta['reason'],'pos':p[:19].round(3).tolist(),'vel':p[19:38].round(3).tolist(),'imu':p[38:].round(3).tolist()}))
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    move_to(-0.8, 1.1, -0.3, 30, 'phase1')
PY
